verdicts.reason: A is just the portrait layout shrunk and pillarboxed into the landscape canvas. The white logo band covers only the centre column, leaving big empty navy areas on both sides. The body copy and 'Ships late June' are tiny, and the orange divider has almost disappeared, but the logo, hierarchy and reading order survive. B breaks the brand: the white header band has slid to the top-right as an empty box, so the dark logo now sits on navy and can barely be seen. The orange divider has drifted far right, away from the text column, and the large gap between headline and body copy looks accidental, though the headline is re-wrapped a little better.
